questions.q:
The mismatched combinations are

A. Chlorophyll$– Co$

B. Water hardness$– EDTA$

C. Photography$- \left[Ag ( CN{)}_{2}\right] -$

D. Wilkinson catalyst$- \left[\left({Ph}_{3}P\right)3RhCl\right]$

E. Chelating ligand$– D -Penicillamine

Choose the correct answer from the options given below.

$
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The chlorophyll molecule has a central magnesium atom engulfed by a nitrogen-containing structure called a porphyrin ring; attached to the ring is a long carbon-hydrogen side chain.

Hardness of water is determined by titrating with a standard solution of ethylene diamine tetra acetic acid (EDTA) which is a complexing agent. Since EDTA is insoluble in water, the disodium salt of EDTA is taken for this experiment. EDTA can form four or six coordination bonds with a metal ion.

Silver bromide is used in photography as a component of an emulsion that helps develop a photographic image. Silver bromide is sensitive to light, and when suspended in gelatin, silver bromide's grains create a photographic emulsion.

Wilkinson's catalyst is the common name for chlorido­tris(triphenylphosphine)­rhodium(I), a coordination complex of rhodium with the formula \left[ \left({Ph}_{3}P\right)3RhCl\right]$

D-Penicillamine is chelating ligand.

$

questions.q:
Arrange the following metal complex/ compounds in the increasing order of spin only magnetic moment. Presume all the three, high spin system.

(Atomic numbers $Ce = 58, Gd = 64$ and $Eu = 63$.)

(a) \left({NH}_{4}\right)2 \left[Ce \left({NO}_{3}\right)$6\right]$

(b) Gd \left({NO}_{3}\right)3$ and

(c) Eu \left({NO}_{3}\right)$3$

$
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
(a)& $Ce 58 \to \left[Xe\right]4f^{2}5d^{0}6s^{2}$

In complex ${Ce}^{4 +} \to \left[Xe\right]4f^{0}5d^{0}6s^{0}$

there is no unpaired electron so ${μ}_{m} = 0$

(b)~${Gd 64}^{3 +} \to \left[Xe\right]4f^{7}5d^{0}6s^{0}$

contain seven unpaired electrons so,~${μ}_{m} = \sqrt{7\left(7 + 2\right)} = \sqrt{63}B . M .$

(c)~${Eu 63}^{3 +} \to \left[Xe 54\right]4f^{6}5d^{0}6s^{0}$

contain six unpaired electron~

so,~${μ}_{m} = \sqrt{6\left(6 + 2\right)} = \sqrt{48}B . M .$

Hence, order of spin only magnetic movement~

$b > c > a$

(Given atomic number of~$Mn = 25$)

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
A spin-only magnetic moment occurs when an electron rotates on its own axis and generates a magnetic field.

$\mu = \sqrt{n ( n + 2 )}BM$
Here, n is the number of unpaired electrons.
The unit for a spin-only magnetic moment is the Bohr magneton (BM).

\left( \left[Mn \left({H}_{2}$O\right)6\right]2 +\right$

${Mn}^{2 +} = 3d^{5}$

$\mu = $\sqrt{5 ( 5 + 2 )} =$5 . 91BM

$
